title: Semantic Search, Skill CRUD & Rich Attachments
summary: Wire vector embeddings into knowledge graph entity lifecycle, implement hybrid semantic search, add drag-drop file attachments to composer, implement Skill Tab CRUD, clean up useChatStreaming.ts technical debt.
approach: 3 waves: Foundation (audit + cleanup) → Core (embedding pipeline, hybrid search, drag-drop, skill CRUD) → Tests. Embedding pipeline uses existing VectorSearch infrastructure. Hybrid search composes FTS5 + vector similarity via existing HybridSearch with RRF fusion.
